requirements.title: The first screen is the checkout, showing a hard-coded catalogue of 8 items, each with a name and a price, as a grid, and tapping an item adds 1 to the cart
The cart lists each item with its quantity, the seller can raise, lower or remove it, and every total updates at once
The subtotal is the sum of price times quantity and tax is 8.875% of it rounded half-up to the cent, so a $4.75 latte and two $3.25 muffins show $11.25 subtotal and $1.00 tax
The tip is none, 15%, 20% or 25% of the subtotal before tax, rounded half-up to the cent, and the total is subtotal plus tax plus tip
Removing the last item empties the cart, and Charge is disabled for an empty cart
Charge shows a receipt of the items, subtotal, tax, tip and total as they were when charged, and New sale empties the cart
Every money value is a Decimal, never a floating-point type
The pricing rules have table-driven unit tests, including rounding at the half cent
The repository's existing tests keep passing
